baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence جَبَلٍ خَاشِعًا مُتَصَدِّعًا مِنْ خَشْيَةِ اللَّهِ joins maximal solidity, lowered posture, fissure, and awe.
baseline_models.mechanism: The counterfactual selects an extremely resistant body and makes inward submission precede outward fracture: awe overcomes height and solidity, then becomes materially visible.

activation_trace.role: An elevated solid mass supplies the mechanism's maximally resistant test body.
Lowering and submission make the first response a posture of yielding rather than mere damage.
A fissure opening in hard matter externalizes the mountain's inward yielding.
Fear joined with awe supplies the stated cause linking submission to fracture.

changed_reading.before: The image hyperbolically says that even a mountain would break.
changed_reading.after: The image models a response sequence: maximal solidity first lowers itself and then fissures as awe becomes materially legible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَرَأَيْتَهُ, الْأَمْثَالُ نَضْرِبُهَا, and يَتَفَكَّرُونَ form a seeing-to-example-to-reflection sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The conditional first makes the addressee see, then identifies the scene as an intentionally rendered example whose impact is meant to keep the heart moving through its implications.

activation_trace.role: Seeing by eye or insight turns the counterfactual into an experienced mental display.
The deliberately offered comparison supplies the display's pedagogical form.
Rendering and manifesting an example makes the imagined scene operative for its audience.
Repeated movement of the heart through a matter supplies the intended continuing cognitive effect.

changed_reading.before: The closing clause merely explains why an illustration was offered.
changed_reading.after: The mountain scene is a deliberately visualized cognitive instrument, made to strike attention and keep reflection in motion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated كَمَثَلِ immediately before the focus ayah makes وَتِلْكَ الْأَمْثَالُ a retrospective collector: historical consequence, relational inducement and abandonment, and material fracture become a staged parable sequence rather than an isolated mountain illustration.

activation_trace.role: A formally offered comparison opens the immediate sequence with a recent historical pattern and its consequence.
A second formally offered comparison shifts the sequence to inducement followed by disavowal.
The focus ayah's deictic plural names the accumulated comparisons as one inspectable set.
Making examples manifest turns the accumulated sequence into a deliberate reflective device.

structural_cues: 59:15 and 59:16 begin with the same كَمَثَلِ construction before 59:21 uses the deictic plural وَتِلْكَ الْأَمْثَالُ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated comparison construction and the later deictic plural; I infer backward gathering and crescendo. A live alternative is that تِلْكَ points generically to a wider stock of examples rather than only the immediate pair and mountain scene.

changed_reading.before: The mountain is a stand-alone illustration followed by a generic comment about parables.
changed_reading.after: The mountain is the material culmination and meta-key of a nearby parable chain moving through historical, relational, and physical forms of collapse.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context supplies an explicit inside-out failure chain: enclosing fortifications seem protective, fear is cast into hearts, and the protected inhabitants demolish their own dwellings. That chain recasts the mountain's fissure as the exterior consequence of an interior affective event.

activation_trace.role: Protection inside an enclosing fortress supplies the apparently secure outer structure.
A forceful casting supplies the directional movement from outside toward the protected interior.
The heart supplies the inner site where the destabilizing event takes hold.
Fear and alarm supply the affect that converts inner penetration into structural failure.
Ruination of built habitation supplies the visible outer result of the interior collapse.
The solid elevated mass transfers the fortress mechanism to the strongest imaginable body.
The hard body's fissure is the focus ayah's outer registration of failure.
Awe-fear locates the mountain's decisive cause in affect rather than mechanical load alone.

structural_cues: 59:2 orders confidence in fortresses, casting into hearts, fear, and self-demolition; 59:21 orders humility before fissure and states awe as cause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both ordered sequences; I align the human heart with a figurative interior of the mountain and treat outer fracture as the result of inner response. The live alternative is straightforward external overpowering with no interior analogy.

changed_reading.before: The mountain cracks because revelation imposes an overwhelming external load.
changed_reading.after: The mountain diagnoses inside-out collapse: apparent protection fails when awe reaches the responsive interior, and the outer structure then dismantles.

context_deltas.mechanism: A group can look like one mountain: scale and walls project a gathered solid exterior while the hearts behind it remain dispersed. The focus root for mountain can denote a great mass, and its fissuring root can denote separation of groups, allowing the material image to expose social fault lines.

activation_trace.role: Twice-stated gathering supplies the claimed and perceived unity of the collective body.
A high wall supplies the external face that makes separation look like solidity.
The hearts supply an interior social structure distinct from the visible exterior.
Dispersion and scattering expose the collective body's concealed internal discontinuity.
A mountain-like great multitude lets the singular mass carry a social-body analogy.
Separation of groups and pieces turns physical fissuring into a model of social division.

structural_cues: 59:14 juxtaposes two occurrences of جَمِيعًا with قُلُوبُهُمْ شَتَّى behind fortifications, while 59:21 redirects the example to people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible gathering, walls, inwardly dispersed hearts, and focus branches for a great mass and group separation; I map the mountain onto a collective body. A live alternative keeps the mountain wholly material and treats 59:14 only as a separate social diagnosis.

changed_reading.before: One solid natural object splits into physical pieces.
changed_reading.after: A mountain-like human mass can appear unified by scale and walls while revelation makes its concealed heart-level divisions visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context turns seeing into an ethical method: rhetorical sight first detects false solidarity, then each self is ordered to inspect what it has advanced, with doubled forgetting naming the failure mode. The mountain therefore functions as a contrastive mirror for the observer rather than a spectacle about another object.

activation_trace.role: Seeing by sight or insight begins the context's demand that the addressee discern hidden social reality.
Directed sight or insight turns perception explicitly toward examination.
Advancing something ahead gives self-examination a concrete future-facing object.
The paired loss of remembrance supplies the cognitive failure that blocks self-recognition.
The addressed observer's imagined seeing makes the mountain available as a self-reflective mirror.
Sustained movement of the heart through the scene converts seeing into reflective self-audit.

structural_cues: 59:11 asks whether the addressee has seen, 59:18 commands a self to look, 59:19 doubles forgetting, and 59:21 again addresses what 'you would see' before calling people to reflect.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the seeing-looking-reflecting arc and the self's advanced deeds; I identify the observer of the mountain with the self under audit. The live alternative is that the mountain only demonstrates divine greatness without redirecting sight onto the observer's own responsiveness.

changed_reading.before: The addressee visualizes how a mountain would react.
changed_reading.after: The addressee must use the mountain as a contrastive mirror: if that massive other would respond, inspect what the self has sent ahead and whether forgetfulness has prevented an answer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The names following the focus ayah place fissure under an agency whose branch field includes both irresistible compulsion and mending a break, followed by measuring, creating, originating, and shaping. This keeps open a reconstructive reading in which fracture is a threshold of re-formation rather than only terminal ruin.

activation_trace.role: Compelling force supplies the irresistible agency capable of overcoming the mountain's settled form.
Mending fracture and deficiency supplies a live restorative horizon beyond the break.
Measuring and proportioning supply an ordering process rather than undirected destruction.
Originating and bringing forth supply the possibility of a new state after disruption.
Giving a formed shape supplies the endpoint of the proposed re-forming process.
The fissure in hard matter supplies the break that the following formative branches reframe.

structural_cues: Immediately after the mountain image, 59:23 names الْجَبَّارُ and 59:24 sequences الْخَالِقُ الْبَارِئُ الْمُصَوِّرُ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repair/compulsion split and the following creation-and-form sequence; I supply the arrow from breaking to re-forming. A materially live alternative is that the names identify only the overwhelming agent and that the fracture remains purely destructive.

changed_reading.before: The mountain's fracture is the terminal destruction of a resistant form.
changed_reading.after: Cautiously, the fracture can mark deconstruction under an authority that also repairs, measures, originates, and reshapes, making responsiveness potentially re-formative.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus grammar presents the mountain's crack as an effect of awe, not as growth. It remains anchored in the ص د ع branch for vegetation splitting earth and is activated by the nearby palm being cut or left standing on its roots. Downstream prose should present it only as a secondary material analogy: the crack can be an opening through a settled surface, not a claim that the mountain literally sprouts.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مُتَصَدِّعًا carries a packet branch in which vegetation splits the ground, allowing fracture to imply emergence as well as disintegration.

activation_trace.role: Severing and separation supply one possible fate of the nearby living material.
The palm supplies the living material that makes a botanical fissure image locally available.
Bodily standing supplies the opposed possibility of continued upright life.
Root and foundation supply the stable base from which standing or emergence remains possible.
Vegetation splitting earth turns the focus fissure into a cautiously emergent opening.

changed_reading.before: Fissuring signifies only the loss of integrity.
changed_reading.after: At the exploratory edge, fissuring can also open a settled surface for emergence, with the nearby cut-or-rooted palm containing that possibility.

strongest_changes: Repeated م ث ل constructions made the mountain the culmination and meta-key of an immediate parable sequence.
The fortress-heart-ruin chain changed external breakage into an inside-out model of affect becoming structural collapse.
The seeing and self-inspection arc turned the imagined mountain into a contrastive mirror for the observer's own responsiveness.
The gathered-versus-scattered contrast opened a social-body reading in which apparent collective solidity conceals heart-level fault lines.
summary.what_was_special: One focus fissure remained materially anchored while becoming legible across pedagogical, affective, social, introspective, and cautiously formative mechanisms; the context changed the function of the mountain without forcing those readings into one synthesis.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether تِلْكَ الْأَمْثَالُ gathers only the immediate comparisons or a broader unstated set remains open.
The repair-and-re-form reading depends on carrying a non-dominant ج ب ر branch across the sequence of divine names.
The social-body analogy should not erase the focus ayah's explicit material counterfactual.
The botanical fissure is lexically and locally anchored but remains a contained analogy rather than a primary reading.
